entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: label_join expects at least 3 arguments (v, dst, separator[, src…]), got %d
entries.rationale: Parser-enforced arity: label_join requires at least the vector, destination label and separator. labelJoinAttributes forwards the same parsed Call for histogram-only lowering. lowerLabelCall receives the original Call from lowerLabelJoin or from the root adapter whose labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer checks the same minimum arity. The shared kernel selects this builder only for label_join and validates before operand lowering, so the caller consolidation introduces no new argument shapes.
